title: Welcome to the MML
author: League Office
summary: The Mario Mania League has a home. Here is what you will find on it.
body:
This is a placeholder story so the Press Box is not empty. Edit or delete it in the Dugout.

Every game the CPUs play gets uploaded here, and the site does the rest: standings, leader boards, box scores, and a page for every team and player.

## Where to look

- **Stats** has every number from the season, sortable by any column.
- **Teams** shows each roster, its totals, and who is running the front office.
- **Players** keeps a card for everyone who has taken the field, with their history.
- **All-Stars** has the Season 2 vote, position by position.

Use the season menu at the top of the page to look back at Season 2.
